customer: Caller, a veteran from Brevin selling his convertible, politely asked what he should do with his license plates when he hands the car over.
agent: Customer asked about license plates when handing over his convertible. Per 'What to do with your license plates,' advised him to remove the plates before handing over the car and keep them. Explained that what he does with them afterward is up to Brevin's motor vehicle agency, and that plates can usually be transferred to his next car.
